scope: Contextual glossary for this whole lesson, not a new doctrinal ruling

entries.Malay: Maha Kaya; tidak memerlukan sesiapa atau apa-apa
entries.context: Divine self-sufficiency, not merely wealth; human inward sufficiency explained separately.

entries.Malay: kebergantungan hamba kepada Allah; sentiasa berhajat kepada-Nya
entries.context: Includes being, qualities, actions and ultimate outcome.

entries.Malay: kezaliman; menzalimi; menganiaya in protected published verse
entries.context: Self/other injustice, misdirected worship and rights distinguished.

entries.Malay: mencipta, memelihara dan mengatur segala urusan
entries.context: Meaning covered naturally without unnecessary untranslated Arabic term.
Offence/displeasure does not establish ability to harm Allah; no source words rewritten.

entries.Malay: kesucian diri; memelihara diri daripada yang haram dan mengingini milik orang
entries.context: Protected prayer says kesucian diri, commentary gives complete relevant scope.
Small, smooth, minimal water; no real treasury depletion.

entries.Malay: kadar yang hampir memenuhi bumi / awan dan ketinggian langit
entries.context: Explained outside unchanged published bekas bumi and mencapai langit.

entries.Malay: hadis qudsi, riwayat Nabi daripada Tuhannya
entries.context: Not Quran; scholarly/source hints about wording not silently converted into a new universal statement.

entries.Malay: meminta pelepasan daripada tuntutan dan mengembalikan hak
entries.context: Not forgiveness request alone while retaining the victim’s rights.
